description:
Create a channel or a project, or change a project's title, brief or
video format. A new project takes its channel's style; a channel with no
style needs one (style_edit action=create) before anything is
generated. Share the returned web_url so the user can follow along.

action.description: create_channel: name, optional description; create_project: channel_id, title, optional description, video_format; update_project: project_id and any of title, description, video_format

description.description: A channel: what it is about. A project: the brief, what the video is about; it seeds the script, so make it specific

video_format.description: landscape (16:9, the default) or portrait (9:16: Shorts, Reels, TikTok); fixed once a storyboard exists

name: projects_edit
title: Edit channels and projects
